caption: The drawing depicts a single candlestick holder centered on a plain background. The candlestick is vertically oriented and rendered in shades of gray, indicating that the artwork is monochromatic, likely created with pencil or graphite. The candlestick has a circular, slightly raised base with concentric bands, a rounded and tapering stem that features symmetrical curves and bulges, and a cylindrical holder at the top for a candle, with a thin, flat circular rim extending outward slightly. The shading on the object provides a three-dimensional appearance, emphasizing the contours and depth of the candlestick against the untextured, light-colored background. There is a thin rectangular border framing the drawing.
title: Candlestick
